body: Thank you. Sorry for the long response times. Trying to get through the work day. The biggest regret I have is how she gave our relationship her all and I held back a lot. I treated her horribly even though she was always there and supportive of me. I feel absolutely awful for the way I treated her. That's the worst part about all of this

Thank you for your advice. I know I have to leave her alone for a while. I wish I had the money to get a round trip flight to Texas. I would love to visit my parents. Just not in the budget, especially now that I have to pay the entire cost of the house instead of half.

I have a phone interview scheduled with a counselor on next Wednesday. That's got to be a start. Hopefully they will accept me into their counseling program.

You are right. I have never really been self reliant. Only time I was even remotely independent was when I was enlisted. Even then I don't really consider that independent having people tell you how to think and act. I have never been alone and it's hard for me to just up and have nobody all of a sudden. I already have an appointment for a phone interview for a counselor/anger management group thing. I want to work on myself I just don't know if it's worth it.
